details.title: Good to know
details.text:
Confetti is welcome, but it must be biodegradable.

The venue is wheelchair accessible. Let us know if you need anything.

The bar opens after the ceremony.

details.text:
The venue is wheelchair accessible. Let us know if you need anything.

The bar is open all evening.

travel.title: By car
travel.text:
There's plenty of free parking. Follow the signs to the customer car park.

You're welcome to leave your car overnight, at your own risk. **All cars must be collected by 11am the next day.**
travel.map: The Castle Westenhanger, Stone Street, Westenhanger, Hythe CT21 4HX

travel.title: By train
travel.text: Westenhanger station is about a 5-minute walk from the castle.

travel.title: Taxis
travel.text: The castle is rural, so please book your taxi home in advance. Carriages are at midnight.
